test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amongst six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U, each has a different height. P is taller than only three other friends. R is taller than only one friend. S is taller than R but shorter than U. T is taller than U. Who is the second tallest among all the friends?
solution:
The following arrangement is as follows:

1) P is taller than only three other friends.

**_ > _ > P > _ > _ > _**

2) R is taller than only one friend

_ > _ > P > _ > R > _

3) S is taller than R but shorter than U and T is taller than U.

**T** > U > P > S > R > _

So as the final arrangement is as follows.

T > U > P > S > R > Q

Therefore, **U **is the second tallest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U".**
